function: SAC agent jointly sets STAR-RIS phase shifts, amplitudes, rotation angle and offloading ratios to minimize user energy; transmit power and CPU allocation are derived outside the policy (p. 7).
system: Single-antenna BS, K single-antenna moving users, rotatable STAR-RIS with N elements (ES, MS, TS protocols), 2-bit phase; 5 MHz bandwidth, carrier frequency not stated (pp. 4, 10).
method: Soft actor-critic deep reinforcement learning with prioritized experience replay; neural-network actor and critics trained by interaction with the simulated environment (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician UD-RIS and RIS-BS links (K1=K2=10, path-loss exponent 2), Rayleigh direct links, Gauss-Markov user mobility; no dataset or measurements (pp. 4-5, 10).
test_conditions: Training and evaluation use the same simulated environment: users in a 2-7 m ring, random seeds 2020-2024; sweeps over N and K, no unseen scenario (pp. 10-11).
baselines: Benchmarks: PPO, DDPG (learned); fixed-orientation STAR-RIS, reflection-only RIS, transmission-only RIS (optimizer not stated); local processing without offloading (non-learned) (pp. 9-11).
metrics: Total user energy consumption in joules; training reward and convergence steps; percentage energy reduction versus fixed STAR-RIS (up to 52.7%) (pp. 10-11).
complexity: Order of complexity given: training O(episodes x length x layer terms), action generation O(L1+L1L2+L2A); no FLOPs or runtime reported (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 5: "modeled as the Rician distribution [14]" and "channels are modeled as Rayleigh fading channels"; a custom simulator, no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "ranging from 2020 to 2024, and calculate the average energy" (random seeds of user mobility only); the paper never tests a trained agent in another scenario, band, K or N.
q3_support: p. 10: "we compare it with PPO and DDPG" (reward curves, Fig. 5); p. 10: "Local Process: UDs execute tasks locally without" offloading, energy compared in Fig. 8 (p. 11).
q4_support: p. 9: "with a generation complexity of O(L1 + L1 L2 + L2 A)." The training complexity is also given in Section IV-C.
q5_support: p. 10: "parameters in our simulation and the hyperparamaters for" the SAC algorithm are listed in Tables III and IV; no code or data link and no public channel dataset.
notes: Included: the learned decision contains STAR-RIS phases, amplitudes and rotation jointly with the offloading ratio (pp. 7-8), so above_phy does not apply; function is RIS configuration, area 3. q3 is borderline: PPO and DDPG appear only in Fig. 5 (reward, the negative energy, versus training steps, p. 10), and the non-learned baseline is local processing (Fig. 8, p. 11) because the fixed-orientation schemes look like variants of the method; a strict reading of the performance rule could give 0, so the reviewer should confirm.
